info.name: Contact Transaction App - Live Tests
info.description: Insomnia-compatible Postman v2.1 collection. Run folders in numeric order. Deactivation runs last. See docs/insomnia-live-test-plan.md for Oracle checks and explanations.

item.name: SETUP-01 Initialize Test Data and Check Gateway Health

request.description: RUN THIS ONCE at the beginning of a complete test pass. It creates unique collection variables and clears prior tokens.
Inspect the HTML response or open the URL in a browser. USER-SERVICE and API-GATEWAY must be UP.

item.name: INF-05 Unknown Gateway Route Is Denied

exec: pm.test("Safe active response", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(b.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('directEmail').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); });

item.name: REG-02 Gateway Registration and Save User ID

exec: pm.test("Save active user", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', String(b.userId)); });
pm.test("Email is lowercase", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('normalizedEmail').toLowerCase()); });

item.name: AUTH-01 Successful Login and Save Token

exec: pm.test("Save bearer token", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.tokenType).to.eql('Bearer'); pm.expect(b.expiresIn).to.eql(1800); pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); });

item.name: AUTH-02 Uppercase and Trimmed Email Login
AUTH-04 Unknown Email Same Generic Error

exec: pm.test("Generic message", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Invalid email or password'); });

request.description: Before sending, copy accessToken into tamperedToken and change one character after the second period.

exec: pm.test("Safe own profile", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId')); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('password'); pm.expect(b).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); });
pm.test("Both fields changed", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.name).to.eql('Gateway Final Name'); pm.expect(b.mobileNo).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('mobileNo')); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test("Only permitted field changed", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.name).to.eql('Allowed Name Change'); pm.expect(b.email).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('email').toLowerCase()); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId')); }); }

request.description: Send at the same time as PROF-08B. The race is timing-dependent in a manual client.
Send at the same time as PROF-08A. Design expectation: one may return 409 CONCURRENT_UPDATE.

item.name: PASS-04 Old Password No Longer Works
PASS-05 New Password Works and Refreshes Token

exec: pm.test("Save new token", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.accessToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); });

item.name: LOGOUT-03 Token Still Works Until Expiry

request.description: V1 logout is stateless, so this 200 response is the documented behavior.

item.name: INT-02 Status With Invalid Internal Token
INT-03 Status With Valid Internal Token

exec: pm.test("Minimal active response", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId')); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(Object.keys(b).sort()).to.eql(['status','userId']); });
pm.test("Resolved user", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(String(b.userId)).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('userId')); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); });

item.name: INT-08 Internal Path Is Blocked At Gateway
06 - Expired JWT (Temporary Restart)
item.description: Temporarily set User Service JWT_EXPIRY=PT1S, restart it, login with the new password, copy that token into shortLivedToken, wait at least 65 seconds, then run EXP-02. Restore PT30M afterward.

exec: pm.test("Token lifetime is one second", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().expiresIn).to.eql(1); });

request.description: Requires User Service JWT_EXPIRY=PT1S. Copy accessToken from the response into shortLivedToken.
Wait at least 65 seconds after EXP-01 before sending.

item.name: EXP-03 Restore Normal Login and Token

exec: pm.test("Save restored token", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.expiresIn).to.eql(1800); pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', b.accessToken); });

request.description: First restore User Service JWT_EXPIRY=PT30M and restart it.

item.name: DEACT-04 Existing Token Blocked By User Status

request.description: Stop User Service and wait for discovery state to update before sending. Restart User Service afterward.

item.name: RES-02 Wrong Gateway Public Key Rejects JWT

request.description: Temporarily configure Gateway with a different RSA public key and restart it before sending. Restore the correct key afterward.
